integration_policy.grouping: Use the ten contiguous content groups and existing TMP source order; do not group by capture prefix or 100-image batch.
integration_policy.contents_links: Link only to audited selected-body anchor locations. Show held entries as plain text or omit from link menu; do not retarget a topic label to a parent as if exact.
integration_policy.ambiguous_titles: Scope repeated generic titles by unit and module context in display/search. This clarifies which source Contents item is meant but does not establish a body target.
integration_policy.glossary: Use exact bilingual Glossary/Glosario heading at TMP-1793 for the single combined Contents link; retain English Glossary at TMP-1735 as a separate in-group heading.
integration_policy.index: Do not expose an Index navigation link because no Index body is available in the 1,899-segment sequence.
integration_policy.printed_labels: Keep null. TMP IDs are internal stable source-order references, never printed page numbers.
integration_policy.source_wording: Preserve source Contents strings. Detailed Contents/body use Module 2.7 plural Communications; Brief Contents singular Communication remains a separate source variant.
